title: Repository developer experience proof ladder guide governance
purpose: Record design-only governance for a human-readable proof ladder guide and developer-experience parent closure without changing proof policy, command routing, validators, evidence rules, or readiness claims.

nonClaims: No proof policy is changed by this artifact.
No command alias, Make target, package script, validator, or workflow is changed by this artifact.
No Dev, Test, Staging, production, deployment, compliance, store, release, live-provider, or human-acceptance readiness claim is made.

guideAudience: owners making promotion or proof decisions
observedGuideNeed.guidePurpose: Give human-readable routing guidance for Dev, Test, Compose-backed proof, Staging proof, generated reports, raw evidence, and human acceptance without upgrading any proof level by implication.

sectionsToInclude: Human acceptance and owner decision boundary
When to stop and ask for owner decision

preserved: The guide explains existing authority and proof routing rather than changing it.
Provider mode and environment remain separate dimensions.
Generated reports remain lower authority than raw evidence and semantic definitions.
Unknown, stale, or missing proof evidence remains fail-closed.
risk: A guide can accidentally sound like policy if it does not cite governing artifacts.
A guide can overclaim readiness if command names are presented without proof-level boundaries.
A guide can confuse production-shaped proof with production-live proof if environment and provider mode are not separated.

validationProofExpectation: Future guide text must cite governing artifacts and must not override the Charter, Authority Model, accepted ADRs, validators, runtime proof evidence, or semantic instances.
Future guide text must preserve the difference between hermetic mock, local composed, live external provider, production-shaped, and production-live claims.
Future guide text must mark generated reports as lowest authority and must not treat a passing report as defining intended behaviour.

parentDeveloperExperienceClosurePolicy.closureBasis: The remaining open child under USF-361 was the human-readable proof ladder guide design issue. Parent closure is valid only as design and governance closure and does not implement guide publication, command changes, validators, setup changes, or proof policy mutation.
nonClosureBoundaries: Actual guide publication remains future documentation work unless separately instructed.
Actual command or workflow changes remain future implementation work.
Actual proof policy changes require the proper authority path and are not made here.
